requirements.title: Operational envelope
requirements.statement: The system shall define approved missions, actors, operating modes and environmental limits for each configuration.
requirements.acceptance: Review mission scenarios, boundaries and measurable envelope; no unresolved operating limit at release.
requirements.source: README.md and common interpretation of three CAD concepts

requirements.title: Module interoperability
requirements.statement: The system shall provide versioned mechanical, power and data interface contracts for interchangeable modules.
requirements.acceptance: Demonstrate module substitution against interface contracts, including incompatible-module rejection.
requirements.source: README.md and common interpretation of three CAD concepts

requirements.title: Local fault response
requirements.statement: The system shall execute a defined local safe or degraded response to each identified critical fault.
requirements.acceptance: Inject critical faults and connectivity loss; measured response meets the approved fault-response matrix.
requirements.source: README.md and common interpretation of three CAD concepts

requirements.title: Energy provision
requirements.statement: The system shall supply mission and essential safety loads within the approved energy budget.
requirements.acceptance: Analyze and test worst-case coincident loads and reserve against the configured mission profile.
requirements.source: README.md and common interpretation of three CAD concepts

requirements.title: Twin identity and provenance
requirements.statement: The digital twin shall associate each state record with asset identity, configuration, timestamp, source and validity.
requirements.acceptance: Replay records and reject or flag stale, missing and mismatched states according to the data contract.
requirements.source: README.md and common interpretation of three CAD concepts

requirements.title: Model verification
requirements.statement: The project shall maintain versioned executable models and reproducible scenarios for each claimed system capability.
requirements.acceptance: Reproduce model runs and correlate selected outputs with bench or prototype data within approved tolerances.
requirements.source: README.md and common interpretation of three CAD concepts

requirements.title: Maintenance access
requirements.statement: The system shall provide documented inspection and replacement procedures for serviceable modules.
requirements.acceptance: Demonstrate inspection and replacement using approved tools, isolation steps and service limits.
requirements.source: README.md and common interpretation of three CAD concepts

requirements.title: Command authorization
requirements.statement: The system shall accept control commands only from authenticated and authorized sources.
requirements.acceptance: Test unauthorized, replayed and malformed commands; verify rejection and event recording.
requirements.source: README.md and common interpretation of three CAD concepts

requirements.title: Configuration traceability
requirements.statement: The project shall trace each requirement to its allocated element, verification result and released configuration.
requirements.acceptance: Audit complete requirement-to-evidence links and disposition of failures before baseline release.
requirements.source: README.md and common interpretation of three CAD concepts

requirements.title: Ground mobility
requirements.statement: The vehicle shall provide propulsion, steering and braking throughout its approved terrain and loading envelope.
requirements.acceptance: Analyze and test handling, braking and grade performance for the worst approved payload and panel configuration.

requirements.title: Panel interchange
requirements.statement: The vehicle shall permit replacement of designated protective panels through documented mounting interfaces.
requirements.acceptance: Demonstrate panel exchange, correct installation and retention under approved structural loads.

requirements.title: Protection objective
requirements.statement: The project shall specify a threat and protection acceptance basis for each claimed protective configuration.
requirements.acceptance: Approve threat cases and assembly-level evaluation plan; close performance evidence before making protection claims.

requirements.title: Occupant egress
requirements.statement: The vehicle shall provide occupant emergency egress in each approved occupied configuration.
requirements.acceptance: Demonstrate access and emergency exit with representative occupants and equipment under defined fault cases.

requirements.title: Payload retention
requirements.statement: The vehicle shall retain cargo and installed modules under the approved service and emergency load cases.
requirements.acceptance: Analyze and test mounts with representative payloads and configuration-specific mass and center of gravity.

requirements.title: Condition monitoring
requirements.statement: The system shall report the health of monitored vehicle and protective modules with their configuration identity.
requirements.acceptance: Introduce monitored faults and verify detection, operator indication and twin association.

requirements.title: Mobile habitat retention
requirements.statement: The mobile habitat shall retain installed equipment and stored supplies throughout the approved travel load envelope.
requirements.acceptance: Analyze and test equipment mounts and vehicle stability for every approved traveling configuration.

requirements.title: Fixed refuge integrity
requirements.statement: The fixed refuge shall maintain structural integrity for the approved site-specific load cases.
requirements.acceptance: Review site, soil, drainage and structural evidence against selected occupancy and environmental loads.

requirements.title: Module reuse
requirements.statement: The habitat system shall support designated shared service modules in both mobile and fixed installations.
requirements.acceptance: Install each shared module in both contexts and demonstrate interface compatibility and isolation.

requirements.title: Habitable environment
requirements.statement: Each occupied habitat shall maintain the approved indoor environmental envelope under declared occupancy and external conditions.
requirements.acceptance: Measure ventilation and indoor conditions in representative occupancy, weather and degraded-service scenarios.

requirements.title: Water segregation
requirements.statement: Each habitat shall keep potable-water circuits isolated from wastewater circuits in all approved modes.
requirements.acceptance: Inspect circuits and test leakage, backflow protection, drainage and maintenance isolation.

requirements.title: Emergency exit
requirements.statement: Each occupied habitat shall provide emergency egress when the normal entrance is unavailable.
requirements.acceptance: Block the normal entrance and demonstrate exit within approved occupant and accessibility criteria.

requirements.title: Service continuity
requirements.statement: Each habitat shall prioritize essential occupied-safety loads during loss of its primary energy supply.
requirements.acceptance: Interrupt primary supply and measure reserve provision, alarms and prescribed degraded operation.

requirements.title: Ground carrier mobility
requirements.statement: The carrier shall provide controlled ground motion within its approved terrain and loaded configuration envelope.
requirements.acceptance: Test braking, steering, traction and stability with the robot stowed and with the carrier unloaded.

requirements.title: Flotation and stability
requirements.statement: The carrier shall maintain approved buoyancy and stability margins for each authorized water loading condition.
requirements.acceptance: Analyze and progressively test displacement, trim, reserve buoyancy and stability with representative loading.

requirements.title: Water maneuvering
requirements.statement: The carrier shall provide controlled propulsion and steering within its approved water operating envelope.
requirements.acceptance: Demonstrate maneuvering and recovery in defined water conditions using the selected propulsion configuration.

requirements.title: Mode transitions
requirements.statement: The carrier shall permit ground-water transitions only when approved transition preconditions are satisfied.
requirements.acceptance: Test valid and invalid transition commands, loading, attitude and ingress states against the guard matrix.

requirements.title: Robot transport
requirements.statement: The carrier shall retain the agricultural robot within its transport bay during approved ground and water operations.
requirements.acceptance: Test restraints, clearances and loaded stability; inhibit travel when required retention status is invalid.

requirements.title: Deployment and recovery
requirements.statement: The system shall provide controlled robot loading and unloading through its ramp within the approved deployment envelope.
requirements.acceptance: Demonstrate deploy and retrieve with representative robot mass, slope and surface conditions; test interlocks.

requirements.title: Cooperative mission
requirements.statement: The system shall coordinate carrier and robot tasks under defined command authority and separation rules.
requirements.acceptance: Run representative cooperative tasks and conflicting commands; verify authority, separation and event history.

requirements.title: Communication loss
requirements.statement: Each mobile agent shall independently execute its approved fallback after loss of the cooperative control link.
requirements.acceptance: Break links during transport and field work; measure each agent response against its fallback limits.

requirements.title: Agricultural operation
requirements.statement: The robot shall execute the selected agricultural task within a declared crop, terrain and human-proximity envelope.
requirements.acceptance: Validate the selected task against approved quality and intervention criteria; no unspecified implement is assumed.

requirements.title: Ingress response
requirements.statement: The carrier shall detect defined critical water-ingress conditions and execute the approved local response.
requirements.acceptance: Inject ingress sensor conditions and verify alarm, transition inhibition and recovery response.
